name: Signature Pad
tagline: Sign with a finger, save the picture. Your signature stays on your device.
description:
Sign with a finger or a mouse. The line thickens and thins the way a pen does. Clear, undo, black ink or blue. When you are done, save a PNG on this device — that file is yours to keep or send.

The last signature stays on this computer — nothing is uploaded.

In a meeting, press Pass the pad, then Invite (in the GifOS menu). Everyone who opens the link gets their own line on the same sheet. You sign yours; you cannot sign theirs. Save the whole sheet as a PNG when the lines are filled.

An unofficial port of signature_pad by szimek. Bugs go to GifOS, not upstream.
